# RN-6 (KOBE-750): chart charts/kaiju (name `kaiju`), images ghcr.io/splittingatom/kaiju-*,
# in-sandbox paths and binaries, in-namespace object names, publish and e2e workflows (spec §3
# changes 4 and 7). By hand: ghcr package visibility, Dependabot paths, chart version bump.
#
# Same format as allowlist.txt (scripts/rename/README.md). The script changes an occurrence only
# where a pattern below matches it AND the allowlist gives it to this step AND no permanent entry
# covers it. Generated files and the allowlist's "Triage:" groups are left out on purpose: the
# dry run lists them as left for hand edits until this step's ticket narrows them into patterns.

== RN-6: Chart directory, chart name and Helm template helpers
** /\bcharts\/kobe\b/
path charts/kobe/** /charts\/kobe/
charts/** /\bkobe\.[a-zA-Z]\w*/
charts/**/Chart.yaml /^name: kobe$/

== RN-6: Image names (ghcr and local tags), the in-sandbox paths and binaries, the images' Unix user `kobe`
** /\bghcr\.io\/splittingatom\/kobe-[\w-]+/
** /(?<![\w.-])kobe-(?:server|web|sandbox|sandbox-agent|mcp-proxy|egress-proxy|model-gateway|orbit-eval|skill-scan|bifrost)(?::[\w.${}-]+)?(?![\w-])/
** /\/opt\/kobe\b/
** /\/run\/kobe-[\w-]*/
** /\bkobe-(?:runas|reclaim|kernel-bridge)\b/
images/** /\b(?:groupadd|useradd)\b[^\n]*\bkobe\b/
